title: textCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Text COMP instances, covering edited text, selection, text measurements, text formatting, cursor placement, keyboard focus, and inherited COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to inspect the text currently being edited, read selected text, or place the cursor by UV coordinates.
Use textHeight and textWidth for the current measured panel text size after updates; use evalTextSize() when the code needs an immediate measurement from the current font settings.
Use formatText(text, editing=True) when the returned string must match the Text COMP formatting used while editing.
Use setCursorPosUV(u, v) to position the cursor from normalized text-panel coordinates.
Use setKeyboardFocus(selectAll=True) when giving the Text COMP keyboard focus should also select all editable text.
